lines.text: The queen of Sheba came to Jerusalem with a large caravan to test Solomon, and he answered all her questions.
She saw Solomon's wisdom, his palace, his table, his servants, and his burnt offerings at the house of the LORD, and it took her breath away.
She said the report she heard was true and blessed the LORD, who set Solomon on His throne to carry out justice and righteousness.
She gave the king 120 talents of silver, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones.
Servants brought algum wood from Ophir, and Solomon made it into steps for the house of the LORD and harps for the gatekeepers.
